page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head centred at top, page number at top left. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Helice signum est Aquilonare viginti septem stellis ursæ majoris effigiem referentibus confor-matum.
Draco sive Anguis, inter ursas sinuoso flexu pro-stratus continet stellas triginta unam.
Bootes est signum septentrionale, prope ursam utramque, viginti duabus potissimum stellis constans.
Corona Ariadnes, imago est septentrionalis octo stellis instar semicirculi condecorata.
Hercules sydus est septentrionale, viginti octo stel-lis conformatum.
Cepheus imago quadantenus obscura, prope Cy-nosuram & Draconem stellis undecim constans.
Lyra, quæ etiam vulturis cadentis effigie notatur: sydus est in cœlis Septentrionale, decem stellis or-natum.
Gallina, quæ etiam Cygni nomine dicitur, est sig-num stellis septendecim conspicuum.
Cassiopea imago decima, sedili refupinato incum-bens capite & stellis conformata tredecim.
Perseus imago est undecima, stellis novendecim condecorata.
Heniochus Pegasi pedibus subjectus, imago est aurigæ in sinistro humero capram gestantis, trede-cim stellis lucens.
Serpentarius sive Ophiuchus est imago Aesculapii,suis manibus serpentem tenentis: viginti quatuor stellis conspicua.
Serpens ab Aesculapio dependens est ejusdem no-minis animal octodecim stellis notatum.
Sagitta est imago telum referens: quinque stellis prope aquilam conspicua.
Aquila signum est effigiem aquilæ avis repræsen-tans: sex stellis illustratum.
Delphinus eodem in loco decem stellis configura-tus apparet.

page.notes: Printed text is set in long-s type; long s is transcribed as s throughout. Possible printer's variants: "Septentrionale" (capital S with ligature-like mark in the scan), "Cassiopea" (the scan is faint at the long s). Some words in the Lyra and Cassiopea entries are blurred but read as shown. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed.
